name: Disney's Grand Californian Hearthstone Lounge Prime Rib Dip on Brioche Roll or Pan-Seared Salmon
brandOrRestaurant: Hearthstone Lounge (Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa · Steps from DCA)
whyItWorks: Just inside the Grand Californian lobby off DCA's Grizzly Peak exit, Hearthstone Lounge serves a tender shaved Prime Rib French Dip with provolone/Swiss and warm au jus (hold horseradish) plus pan-seared salmon and kids' plain pasta.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Prime Rib Dip with **NO horseradish cream** and **NO caramelized onions**, dipped in warm au jus so the roll melts in your mouth.
watchOuts: Always ask for no horseradish cream and no grilled onions
